docs.title: Cross-linking
docs.text:
Link between pages with relative Markdown links (the build validates them, so broken links fail CI):

[Example Location](locations/example-location.md)
[a character](characters/example-character.md)

Renders as: Example Location.

docs.title: System windows (admonitions / callouts)
docs.text:
Standard types — note, tip, warning, danger, info, example, quote — all work. Plus five custom System flavors:

SYSTEM

Use for in-world System messages and notifications.

PROFILE

Use for character / location / faction stat blocks.

<SCENARIO NAME>

Use for quests, trials, and scenarios. Wrap the title in < >.

REWARD

Use for loot, coins, and prizes.

PENALTY

Use for costs, punishments, and failure conditions.

Syntax:

!!! scenario "<MAIN SCENARIO #1>"
    **CLEAR CONDITION:** ...

Collapsible variant with ???:

Click to expand

Hidden content lives here.

docs.title: Diagrams (Mermaid)
docs.text:
```mermaid
graph LR
  A --> B
```

Renders as:

graph LR
  A[Awakening] --> B[First Scenario]
  B --> C{Survive?}
  C -->|Yes| D[Next Scenario]
  C -->|No| E[Death]
